name: args-00
stdout:
usage: airpods diag [-h] [--version] [--seconds SECONDS] [--serial SERIAL]
                    [--output OUTPUT] [--legacy] [--inspect] [--phone]
                    [--radio] [--no-trace] [--replace]

Read-only Pico audio diagnostics over Windows HID or Linux hidraw. No
companion app is needed. Output is JSON Lines; use --output to retain a
bounded capture locally.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --version          show the version and exit
  --seconds SECONDS
  --serial SERIAL    Require this Pico serial
  --output OUTPUT    JSONL destination (default stdout)
  --legacy           Only existing feature 5/9 snapshots
  --inspect          Include signal levels and the latest submitted AAC-ELD
                     frame
  --phone            Include phone input queue and decoder counters
  --radio            Only cached radio and adaptive-bitrate readings, every
                     two seconds
  --no-trace         Leave out the timing counters and recent events; unlike
                     --legacy it combines with --inspect and --phone
  --replace          Overwrite the --output file if it exists
